title: PRINCIPLES OF MARKETING
description: Covers concepts and principles used by marketing professionals. Designed explicitly for business majors, it’s an introduction to the relationships between customers, products, and companies in a competitive and dynamically evolving marketplace.
registration_restrictions:
Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
recommendations: ECON 201Z with a minimum grade of C-
clssnotes:
BA 223/223H is mutually exclusive to BA 390/390H. Mutual Exclusions Info.
